title: Prompt maintenance diagnosis
principle: Manage prompt templates as versioned application dependencies. Test variables, schema, and release links.
prerequisites: Identify the outcome for prompt maintenance diagnosis.
Collect relevant evidence.
mechanism: Inspect unresolved variables, incompatible request fields, prompt version, and changed instructions. Compare logs and traces with a known-good version.
